name: Twilight Base Camp
summary: At Twilight Base Camp, the Twilight's Hammer gathers in Silithus to summon elemental powers and advance its apocalyptic cause. Wind stones mark the camp, and armed cultists stand ready.

sections.title: A Bastion of Doom
sections.body: Twilight Base Camp is one of several Twilight's Hammer enclaves in Silithus. Zealots, geomancers, and stonecallers gather among jagged ritual stones to summon elemental forces. Twilight Keeper Havunth and Twilight Lord Everun direct their efforts to hasten Azeroth's end. Cenarion Hold forces seek to restore balance to the region, but the cult openly defies them.

sections.title: The Wind Stones
sections.body: Lesser and greater wind stones stand throughout the outpost. The Twilight's Hammer uses cryptic incantations and cult regalia at these monuments to draw chaotic elemental spirits into the physical realm. Travelers and scouts work to disrupt the rites before the cult's influence spreads across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is the Twilight Base Camp?
faq.answer: Twilight Base Camp is an armed Twilight's Hammer outpost in the Silithus deserts. Cultists conduct rituals there to summon elemental entities.
Zealots of the Twilight's Hammer man the outpost under overseers such as Twilight Keeper Havunth and Twilight Lord Everun.

faq.q: What are the strange stones in the camp?
faq.answer: The wind stones are mystical conduits of varying size. Cultists use them to pierce planar barriers and bind elemental creatures to their service.

faq.q: Why are the Twilight's Hammer in Silithus?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer seeks the chaotic energies beneath Silithus's sands. They hope to awaken dark powers and summon elementals to destroy the world.

angles.text: As a shaman, you see the cult's use of wind stones to subjugate elemental spirits as an affront to spiritual harmony.
As a paladin, you face the threat the cult's apocalyptic rites pose to peace. The Holy Light calls you to answer.
